title: 第21章 天网恢恢
content_zh:
但旁人一时忘记了他，温老太可没忘记，她只在胖子初进来时瞧了一眼，目光始终不离闵嘉庚，见他要逃，立时厉声喝呼，纵身而前，伸掌往他背心拍去，这掌正是八卦掌绝招之一的“背心钉”，只要拍中了，当场要叫他骨断脏裂，呕血而死。

    那胖子见她以如此毒辣手法对付一个孩子，噫了一声，正要出手相救，却见闵嘉庚身形一动，左手倒钩，带着她手掌甩出。温老太一个踉跄，跌出三步方凝桩站定。那胖子见闵嘉庚小小的一个孩子居然有此武功，大为惊奇，不由向他连望几眼。

    厉宏生见了这胖子，依稀有些面熟，一时却想不起来，抱拳问：“尊驾高姓大名？暮夜光临，有何见教？”那胖子抱拳还礼，说道：“不敢，兄弟姓王。”带着一口浙江口音。厉宏生猛地想起，说道：“啊，原来是王主任光临，当真恕小弟眼拙。”群豪一听，眼前此人竟是协力社主任王万户，无不耸然动容。

    六年前，协力社大闹维京乃轰动武林的大事，天下皆知。此后协力社便默默无闻，江湖传言群豪豹隐阿拜，不料王万户突然在此出现。厉宏生年轻时曾在万澜申城总部见过他一面，但事隔二十余年，王万户早已非复旧时容颜，因此初见面时竟想不起来。此时他加倍留神，满脸堆欢说：“王主任是一人前来武定，还是社员们一起出山了？先父生前提到协力社都好生崇敬。”他知协力社和公家作对，个个是重犯，但这些人个个得罪不得，心想事不关己，虚与委蛇便了。

    王万户性子慈和，胸无城府，跟谁都合得来，随口回答：“是小弟一人有点私事，来到此地。请问令尊是……”厉宏生听他只有一人，放下了一大半心，暗想：“倘若他们倾巢而出，在这里撞见了可不好办。”回答：“先父是万澜物流……”王万户接口说：“啊，原来是厉总的贤郎，怎么厉总仙游了吗？”神色黯然，却是真正的难过。

    厉宏生说：“先父已去世五年了。这是舍弟宏明。”他转头对厉宏明说：“王主任太极拳、太极剑、暗器功夫三绝，天下无双，今日当真幸会。”

    他正要替各人引见，厉宏明心直口快，已接口说：“这位魏兄也是太极门的，两位本来相识么？”说着向魏从善一指。

    王万户哼了声，慈和的脸上顿时现出一层黑气，向魏从善从头看到脚，又从脚看到头，细**量。魏从善见他脸色忽变，微觉局促不安，给他这么一瞧，更为尴尬。

    王万户携来的女孩突然伸手指着他大声说：“就是他！就是他！”声音尖细，语气中充满了愤怒。

    魏从善见这小女孩肤色微黑，脸上满是痛恨之色，自己却从没见过，转过头向厉宏明说：“王主任是南派温州太极门，兄弟是北派邯郸太极门，我们是同派不同宗。王主任是本门前辈，兄弟向来仰慕得紧。”说着走近身去，抱拳为礼，神色恭敬。

    哪知王万户宛如不见，双手负在背后，对他不理不睬，转身向厉宏生说：“厉兄，兄弟今日来得鲁莽，先向各位谢过。”说着团团作揖。众人连忙还礼，都说：“好说好说，王主任太客气了。”只把魏从善气得半身冰凉，拱着的手一时放不下来，僵在当地，心想：“我几时得罪你了？你名头虽大，难道我当真怕你不成？”

    厉宏生指着闵嘉庚说：“这位小兄弟跟我师嫂有点过节，那多半是他上代结下来的梁子。现下他先人和我师哥都已过世多年了，我们冲着王主任的金面，这件事揭过不提。大家罢手如何？”

    温宏伟当年虽然是厉士玉的大弟子，后来偷盗总部秘籍潜回老家武定练习，这才闯出了紫金刀客的名头。因为此事，厉氏兄弟与温宏伟不和，本就无意为他报仇，此时更想卖王万户一个好。王万户愕然不解。温老太已叫骂起来：“什么王万户、王千户，到温家堡来，在老娘跟前，谁都别想撒野！”王万户说：“厉兄说的是什么，在下可不明白。”

    厉宏生说：“我这师嫂是妇道人家，王主任别理会她。来来来，小弟借花献佛，敬王主任一杯。”说着便去斟酒。

    闵嘉庚知道再说下去，自己谎话立时就要拆穿，大声说：“王主任，这些家伙吹牛，那也罢了。他们却说协力社个个都是脓包，又说万澜功夫天下无敌，说他们的老英雄单凭一柄紫金八卦刀就打败了协力社所有人。小的听不过了，因此出来辩驳。他们不服，跟我动手。王主任，你说气人不气人？这个理要请你来评一评了。”

    王万户全不知他们争些什么，但当年厉士玉曾和协力社对敌，这件事倒是有的，协力社也没凭武力胜他，只使计逼得他服输，想来厉氏兄弟说起此事时，定是夸他父亲英雄了得，那也是人情之常，便笑了笑说：“厉总武功高强，我们都十分佩服。”突然目光如电，射向魏从善，说道：“魏师傅，请你跟我出去，咱们借一步说话。”

    魏从善心中一凛，说道：“在下和王主任素不相识，不知有何吩咐？这儿各位朋友都是光明磊落的好汉子，有话就请在此明说不妨。”王万户冷笑一声说：“这是我太极门门户之耻，何必让旁人知晓？”魏从善脸上变色，退后一步，朗声说：“你是温州南太极，我是邯郸北太极，咱们同派不同宗。我管不着你，你也管不着我。”王万户说：“就只为魏师傅手段太过厉害，北宗太极门没人能出头，兄弟才万里迢迢地从哈萨克赶来。兄弟到了维京，听说魏师傅到山东来啦，一路寻访而来，总算是天网恢恢。”

    众人听他用到“天网恢恢”四字，都吃了一惊，不知魏从善在门户中干了什么歹事，累得这位协力社主任万里追寻。

    魏从善精明强干，在江湖上成名多年，名头固不及王万户响亮，却也是北太极门的佼佼者，何况跟了吴总后，有了极强靠山，对王万户毫不畏惧，厉声说：“我先前尊你一声前辈，那是瞧在你年纪份上。你我南北太极各有所长，凭你就能压得了我吗？”语声甫毕，一招“玉女穿梭”猛向他肩头拍去。

    王万户追奔数月，辛劳万里，为的就是此刻，一见魏从善出手，从这招“玉女穿梭”之中，于他武功修为已了然于胸，身躯微蹲，一招云手带住他的手腕向右牵引。魏从善立足不定，顿时全身受制。要知各派太极拳剑、招法、要旨大同小异，强弱差别全在各人的悟性与功力修为不同。

    李云是魏从善至交，当二人口头相争时，他已拔剑在手，跃跃欲试，眼见魏从善一招即败，便即挺剑向王万户身后刺去，喝声：“放手！”王万户更不回身，顺手在魏从善腰间抽出佩剑，回剑一挡。这下分寸拿捏得恰到好处，双剑一交，铛的一声，李云的长剑已断成两截。王万户右手回送，又将长剑插入魏从善腰间剑鞘。

    群豪见他一招制住魏从善、一剑震断李云长剑，制敌拳法之精、拔剑出手之快、断剑功力之纯、还剑眼力之准皆生平罕见，不由尽皆失色。他回剑入鞘这招如是插向魏从善身上，魏从善早已了账。魏从善自己心中也自了然。王万户向魏从善冷然问：“怎么？你还不肯出去？”魏从善脸上青一阵红一阵，惊惶不定。

    突然金光闪动，七枝金钱镖分从上下左右向闵嘉庚急射过去。原来温老太眼见报仇之望行将成空，见众人注目二人，正是良机，猛地一口气发出七枝金钱镖。她与闵嘉庚相距不过丈许，这下陡然发难，对方要能将七枝金钱镖尽数躲过当真千难万难。她十余年来处心积虑要为丈夫复仇，知道秦英豪与闵恩仇武功卓绝，光明正大地动手，绝难取胜，因此镖上都喂了见血封喉的剧毒。

    这下突如其来，闵嘉庚叫声：“哎呀！”急忙扑倒，上面三枝镖虽能避过，打向他小腹和下盘的四枝镖却再也无法闪躲。
content_en:
But others forgot about him for a moment, but Mrs. Wen did not forget. She only glanced at the fat man when he first came in, and her eyes never left Min Jiageng. When she saw that he was about to run away, she immediately shouted sharply, jumped forward, and slapped his vest with her palm. This palm was the "vest nail" one of Baguazhang's unique skills. If it hit, his bones would be broken and his internal organs would be broken, and he would vomit blood and die.
The fat man saw that she was using such a vicious method to deal with a child. He groaned and was about to come to the rescue, but he saw Min Jiageng move and throw out her palm with the barb of his left hand.Old Mrs. Wen stumbled, fell three steps and stood still on the pile.The fat man was greatly surprised to see that such a small child like Min Jiageng had such martial arts skills, and couldn't help but look at him several times.
When Li Hongsheng saw the fat man, he looked vaguely familiar, but he couldn't remember it for a moment. He clasped his fists and asked, "What's your surname? I'm here at midnight, what can I say?" The fat man clasped his fists in return and said, "I don't dare, my brother's surname is Wang." He said with a Zhejiang accent.Li Hongsheng suddenly remembered and said, "Ah, it turns out that Director Wang is here. Please forgive me for my clumsy eyesight." When the heroes heard that the person in front of them was Wang Wanhu, the director of the Cooperation Society, they were all shocked and moved.
Six years ago, the Cooperation Society's riot against the Vikings was a major event that caused a sensation in the martial arts world and was known to the whole world.Since then, the Xieli Society has been unknown, and there are rumors in the world that the powerful people have disappeared, but Wang Wanhu suddenly appears here.Li Hongsheng had met him once at the Wanlan Shencheng headquarters when he was young. However, more than twenty years later, Wang Wanhu's appearance had long since changed, so he couldn't remember it when they first met.At this time, he paid more attention and said with joy on his face: "Did Director Wang come to Wuding alone, or did all the members come out together? When my father mentioned the cooperative society before his death, he was very respectful." He knew that the cooperative society was against the public, and all of them were serious offenders.
Wang Wanhu has a kind-hearted nature, has no ambitions, and gets along well with everyone. He replied casually: "I am here because I have some personal matters. May I ask if your father is..." Li Hongsheng was relieved when he heard that he was alone, and thought to himself: "What if he is alone?"They all came out in droves.It would be difficult to meet him here." He replied: "My father is Wanlan Logistics..." Wang Wanhu said, "Ah, it turns out he is Mr. Li's wise man.Why did Mr. Li Xianyou?" His expression was sad, but he was really sad.
Li Hongsheng said: "My father has been dead for five years. This is my younger brother Hongming." He turned to Li Hongming and said: "Director Wang has three unique skills in Tai Chi, Tai Chi Sword, and Hidden Weapon Kung Fu. He is unparalleled in the world. I am truly honored to meet you today."
Just as he was about to introduce everyone, Li Hongming spoke outright and said, "Brother Wei is also from the Taiji sect. Do you two know each other?" He pointed to Wei Congshan.
Wang Wanhu snorted, and a layer of black energy suddenly appeared on Ci He's face. He looked at Wei Congshan from his head to his feet, and then from his feet to his head, looking carefully.Wei Congshan felt a little embarrassed when he saw his expression change suddenly. He felt even more embarrassed when he saw him like this.
The girl Wang Wanhu brought suddenly pointed at him and said loudly: "That's him! That's him!" The voice was shrill and full of anger.
Wei Congshan saw that the little girl had a dark complexion and a look of hatred on her face, but he had never seen it before. He turned to Li Hongming and said, "Director Wang is from the southern Wenzhou Tai Chi Sect, and my brother is from the northern Handan Tai Chi Sect. We are from the same sect but from different sects. Director Wang is a senior in our sect, and my brothers have always admired her very much." As he said this, he walked closer and held his fists in front of him with a respectful expression.
Unexpectedly, Wang Wanhu seemed to have disappeared. He put his hands behind his back and ignored him. He turned to Li Hongsheng and said, "Brother Li, I'm so reckless for coming today. I want to thank you all in advance." After that, they bowed to each other.Everyone hurriedly returned the courtesy and said: "It's easy to say, Director Wang is so polite." Wei Congshan was so angry that his whole body went cold. He couldn't let go of his cupped hands for a while, and froze in the place, thinking: "When did I offend you? Although you have a great reputation, am I really afraid of you?"
Li Hongsheng pointed at Min Jiageng and said: "This little brother has some issues with my senior sister-in-law. It is probably due to the feud created by his predecessors. Now his ancestors and my senior brother have passed away for many years. For the sake of Director Wang's golden face, we did not mention this matter. How about we give up?"
Although Wen Hongwei was Li Shiyu's eldest disciple, he later stole secrets from the headquarters and sneaked back to his hometown of Wuding to practice, and then he became famous as the Purple Gold Swordsman.Because of this matter, the Li brothers were at odds with Wen Hongwei and had no intention of avenging him. At this time, they even wanted to sell Wang Wanhu out.Wang Wanhu was stunned and confused.Old Mrs. Wen was already shouting and scolding: "Wang Wanhu, Wang Qianhu, come to Wenjiapu, no one can act wild in front of me!" Wang Wanhu said: "I don't understand what Brother Li is talking about."
Li Hongsheng said: "My sister-in-law is from a woman's family, Director Wang, please ignore her. Come on, come on, I will borrow flowers to offer to Buddha and give Director Wang a drink." After that, he went to pour wine.
Min Jiageng knew that if he kept talking, his lie would be exposed immediately, so he said loudly: "Director Wang, these guys are bragging, so that's fine. But they said that everyone in the cooperative is a pustule, and that Wanlan Kung Fu is invincible, and that theirsThe old hero defeated everyone in the Xieli Club with just a purple-gold Bagua knife.The younger one couldn't stand it, so he came out to argue.Director Wang, do you think this is annoying or not?I want you to comment."
Wang Wanhu had no idea what they were fighting about, but there was a fact that Li Shiyu had been an enemy of the Xielishe in the past. The Xielishe did not defeat him with force, but only used tricks to force him to admit defeat. I think when the Li brothers talked about this, they must have praised his father.It's human nature to be a hero, so he smiled and said, "We all admire Mr. Li for his great martial arts skills." Suddenly his eyes were like lightning, and he shot at Wei Congshan and said, "Master Wei, please come out with me, and we can take a step to talk."
Wei Congshan's heart trembled, and he said: "I have never met Director Wang, what are your orders? All my friends here are upright and upright men. If you have anything to say, please express it here." Wang Wanhu sneered and said, "This is the shame of my Taiji sect. Why should others know about it?" Wei Congshan's face changed color, he took a step back and said loudly: "You are Wenzhou NanTaiji, I am Handan North Taiji, we are from the same sect.I can't control you, and you can't control me." Wang Wanhu said: "It's just because Master Wei is so powerful that no one in the Taiji sect can stand out, so my brother came all the way from Kazakhstan.When my brother arrived in Viking, he heard that Master Wei was coming to Shandong, and he came all the way to look for him."
Everyone was shocked when they heard that he used the words "天网 huge". They didn't know what evil deeds Wei Congshan had done in the sect, which made the director of the cooperative society search for thousands of miles.
Wei Congshan is smart and capable, and has been famous in the world for many years. Although his reputation is not as famous as Wang Wanhu's, he is also a leader in the North Taiji Sect. What's more, he has a strong backer with General Wu, and he is not afraid of Wang Wanhu.He said: "I respected you as a senior before, but it was because of your age. You and I have our own strengths in Northern and Southern Tai Chi. Can you defeat me?" As soon as he finished speaking, he slapped him on the shoulder with the "Jade Girl Shuttle" move.
Wang Wanhu had been chasing for several months, working hard for thousands of miles, just for this moment, when he saw Wei Congshan take action, and from this "Jade Girl Shuttle" move, he had a clear understanding of his martial arts skills. He squatted slightly, and with a move of Yun Shou, he took his wrist and pulled it to the right.Wei Congshan was unsteady and his whole body was immediately restrained.It is important to know that the swords, moves, and gist of each Tai Chi school are very similar, and the difference in strength lies in each person's understanding and skill.
Li Yun was Wei Congshan's best friend. When the two were arguing verbally, he had drawn his sword and was eager to try. Seeing that Wei Congshan was defeated with one move, he thrust his sword behind Wang Wanhu and shouted: "Let go!"This time, with perfect timing, the two swords crossed each other, and with a clang, Li Yun's long sword was broken into two pieces.Wang Wanhu returned with his right hand and inserted the long sword into the scabbard on Wei Congshan's waist.
When the heroes saw that he had restrained Wei Congshan with one move and broken Li Yun's long sword with one strike, his skill in defeating the enemy's boxing, his speed in drawing the sword, his pure sword-breaking skills, and his accuracy in returning the sword were all rare in his life.He sheathed his sword and stabbed Wei Congshan in this way. Wei Congshan had already settled the matter.Wei Congshan knew it in his own mind.Wang Wanhu asked Wei Congshan coldly: "What? You still refuse to go out?" Wei Congshan's face turned green and red, and he was frightened.
Suddenly golden light flashed, and seven money darts shot towards Min Jiageng from up, down, left and right.It turned out that Mrs. Wen saw that her hope of revenge was about to be in vain. Seeing that everyone was paying attention to the two of them, it was a good opportunity and she suddenly fired seven money darts in one breath.She and Min Jiageng were only a few feet away from each other, and now they suddenly got into trouble. It was really difficult for the other party to evade all seven money darts.She had been plotting to avenge her husband for more than ten years. She knew that Qin Yinghao and Min Enqiu were extremely skilled in martial arts and it would be impossible to win if they fought openly and honestly, so the darts were all fed with poison that would seal their throats when they see blood.
This attack came suddenly, and Min Jiageng shouted: "Oops!" He hurriedly threw himself down. Although he could avoid the three darts from above, the four darts that hit his lower abdomen and lower body could no longer dodge.
